title: Playboy Magazine September 2001 Jerri Manthey Dale Earnhardt Jr NFL Preview
conditionDescription: Pre-owned issue, complete. Normal signs of age and storage; possible cover wear, creases and edge/corner wear. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Playboy Magazine, September 2001 issue. Cover price $5.99.

Features:
- Survivor's Jerri Manthey - cover and pictorial
- Driving Destiny: Dale Earnhardt Jr. interview
- 2001 NFL Preview, with a special appearance from Tony Siragusa
